mappings.note: Whose diary the excerpts come from -- knowing the text one has read, not a detail inside it, so the read-with-comprehension LO rather than LO-134.
What the mist did -- a point stated in the diary.
Why he could not see Bijju -- a reason given in the text.
How he described the early monsoon rain -- a stated description.
Which plant reared its head on his walk -- stated detail.
Completing 'the ___ affords a certain privacy' -- recall of a stated line.
How he described the hill station and valley -- a stated description.
Which seasonal visitors the rain heralded -- stated detail.
Whom the visitor lifted from near the servants' quarters -- stated detail.

Who chases the minivets away -- stated detail.
Which birds cannot conceal themselves -- stated detail.
Completing 'no dearth of food for the ___' -- recall of a stated line.

'His eyes were ... bad that he couldn't read' -- the so/such structure, grammar rather than a poem item.
'decide ... and for all' -- completing a fixed function-word phrase, grammatical usage.
